newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-CHOICE OF UNIBANKA, VENTSPILS ISSUER MID-MAY.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-CHOICE OF UNIBANKA, VENTSPILS ISSUER MID-MAY.

text.p: A decision on who will issue global depository receipts for leading bank Unibanka and arrange the sale abroad of a Ventspils Nafta stake will be made in mid-May, the privatisation agency said on Wednesday.
"The tender (the choice of financial intermediary) itself could take place in mid-May or the last weeks of May," privatisation agency general director Janis Naglis told a news conference.
He said that the agency has held talks with Bankers Trust and was still discussing pricing with Nomura and Daiwa.
Unibanka plans to issue GDRs worth $10 million while the government is to offer seven percent of Ventspils to foreign investors.
